name: Tsukiko
source:
Tsukiko — A tsundere fox girl.

She harbors feelings for the protagonist and fights alongside them to return to their world.
Her physical abilities are greatly enhanced in the other world.
Viewing monsters as similar to animals, she begins to question whether killing the Demon King is the right thing to do.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228054440/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.kitsuneisekaicol]Google Play[/url]]
